title: Where Autonomy Belongs: A Separation of Powers for Agentic Program Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.15309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-driven program evolution rests on three decisions: govern directs the search from accumulated evidence, propose constructs the next candidate, and judge settles validity and fitness. All three appear in every system, and existing work splits into two lines over who makes each. Controller-centric systems strengthen govern and neglect the autonomy of propose, which caps what evolution can reach. Agent-centric systems let a coding agent take over both govern and propose, at a cognitive and computational cost. Neither line protects the independent authority of judge, so benchmark reliability suffers. These failures share one root: autonomy is misallocated across the three decisions. We address this problem with EvoTrias, a separation-of-powers architecture in which each decision has one owner: Structured Governance for what spans evolution rounds, Open Proposal for construction inside a task, and Protected Judgment behind a private evalu

translated_title: 自主权属于何方：面向智能体程序演化的三权分立架构
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的程序演化建立在三项决策之上：govern（治理）依据积累的证据引导搜索方向，propose（提议）构建下一个候选方案，judge（评判）裁定有效性与适应度。这三项决策存在于每一个系统中，现有工作根据由谁作出每项决策而分为两条路线。以控制器为中心的系统强化govern却忽视propose的自主性，从而限制了演化所能达到的上限；以智能体为中心的系统让一个编码智能体同时接管govern和propose，却付出了认知与计算上的代价。两条路线都未能保护judge的独立权威，因此基准评测的可靠性受损。这些失败有着共同的根源：自主性在三项决策之间被错误分配。我们提出EvoTrias来解决这一问题——这是一种权力分立架构，其中每项决策都有唯一的所有者：跨越演化轮次的决策由结构化治理负责，任务内部的构建由开放式提议负责，而受保护的评判则置于私有的评估器（原文在此处截断）之后。
tldr: 论文提出EvoTrias三权分立架构，将LLM驱动的程序演化中的治理、提议、评判三项决策分别交由独立的所有者负责，以解决自主性分配不当导致的演化上限受限与基准评测可靠性受损问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EvoTrias, a separation-of-powers architecture that assigns each of the three decisions in LLM-driven program evolution—governance, proposal, and judgment—to a dedicated independent owner, resolving the misallocation of autonomy that limits evolutionary reach and undermines benchmark reliability.
